text: • Check for tick bite (small dark brown/black scab). If tick bite or tick present and headache, temperature ≥ 38°C or body pain, tick bite fever likely 38. • If unexplained rash or lesion/s of skin/genitals/anus/rectum/mouth/eyes and ≥ 1 of: headache/backache/body pain, swollen lymph nodes, temperat

detail.problem: Parts judged: (1) 'tick bite or tick present' = Tick bite OR Infestation caused by Ixodidae OR Infestation caused by Argasidae: correct (SNOMED has no plain 'tick present' finding; the two infestation disorders cover hard and soft ticks). (2) 'and headache, temperature >= 38C or body pain' = and + or(Headache, >= Body temperature 38, Generalized aches and pains): correct, right comparator and unit. (3) 'tick bite fever likely' = probable Spotted fever group rickettsial disease: correct. Closer children exist (African tick bite fever, South African tick-bite fever/Boutonneuse fever) but the page does not distinguish R. africae from R. conorii, so the common parent is the right choice. (4) mpox 'unexplained rash or lesion/s of skin/genitals/anus/rectum/mouth/eyes' = or(Skin lesion, Lesion of genitalia, Lesion+finding_site Anal structure, Lesion of rectum, Oral lesion, Lesion of eye): correct; Generalized rash is_a Skin lesion so the presenting rash satisfies it; there is no precoordinated anal-lesion disorder so finding_site is the right form. (5) '>= 1 of headache/backache/body pain, swollen lymph nodes, temperature > 38.5C, fatigue, sore throat/nasal congestion/cough' = or of nine items with > 38.5: correct, all nine present. (6) 'consider mpox' = possible Monkeypox: correct (Mpox is a synonym of Monkeypox in this release). (7) 'started any medication ... in the past 3 months' = (<= (onset exposure to Drug or medicament) (time_ago 3 months)): correct direction per the briefing's convention (<= time_ago N = within the last N); the named examples (antiseizure, ART, TB drugs, co-trimoxazole, TPT) are covered by the generic substance. (8) 'consider drug rash' = possible Eruption caused by drug: correct. (9) 'Test for syphilis and HIV' is a test order (management); its results are checked for as Syphilis titer detected / not detected and HIV not detected. The positive HIV result is not checked for; see p87-fd394714.
